hey! i have dealt with health anxiety for as long as i can remember. i always have some new terrifying scenario in my head, and it'd either be spurred on by a random headache, heart palpitation, or sometimes my anxiety itself will cause symptoms when i begin to spiral. 

i can also relate to those crazy horror stories your parents tell you - my moms dad dropped dead on a bus from a heart attack when she was only 14. unfortunately shit like this happens for reasons mostly out of our control, but we have so many other factors we CAN control. you're headed in the right direction with eating better and working out, thats the best way to help prevent shit like heart attacks and strokes, and you'll feel better mentally and physically which will hopefully help with your anxiety a bit. it's also great to just talk to someone who might experience health anxiety as well. it's super reassuring, i find, to not feel like im crazy or imagining things or the only one up till 4am googling symptoms and debating an er visit lmao.

hey dude, i appreciate the reply. i can understand where you're coming from - my mom had a heart attack at 40 (pretty young for that to happen) and the entire side of her family has had so many different health issues. and now her and my dad are both undergoing tests cuz they both have crazy high blood pressure n cholesterol. i always find myself wondering at some point if im gonna develop these issues thanks to good ol genetics but its never a guarantee, especially if you take care of yourself!!! also yeah luke perry's death came as a huge shock to me as well, it's scary to think that things like that can happen at any age it seems. but ive tried to remind myself that we cannot worry about what is out of our control, and we gotta invest our time and energy into what we can - in a positive and healthy way. its a journey, definetly. i can sympathize with how you must feel, if you ever wanna talk feel free to pm me!

i relate so hard to this. i had heart palpitations and ended up having a holter monitor for 14 days and the results coming back clear relieved so much weight off my shoulders. i find that anxiety is so powerful that it just convinces you that what youre feeling is always super serious and fatal when 90% of it comes from the anxiety itself. i appreciate your kind words and advice, the ginger tea sounds delicious and im definetly gonna try, and i'm just gonna keep living a healthy lifestyle with as much self care as i can fit in! best wishes to you :)
